# Thatch & Trail

> A free, independent guide to visiting vineyards in England, Wales and the Channel Islands: 150 vineyards and wineries open to visitors, 127 of them estate-verified. Each listing covers opening days, tours and tastings, food, places to stay, dogs and children, and how to get there without a car.

"Estate-verified" means the estate itself confirmed the details to Thatch & Trail by email; the month of confirmation is shown on each page. Details not confirmed by the estate are labelled "From their website". Thatch & Trail does not accept payment for listings or reviews. Last updated November 2026.

## Find vineyards
- [All vineyards and the UK map](https://thatchandtrail.com/): every estate, filterable by region, food, stay and verified status
- [Regions](https://thatchandtrail.com/regions/): one page per region
- [Vineyards near you](https://thatchandtrail.com/near/): vineyards near major towns, nearest first, with distances
- [What estate-verified means](https://thatchandtrail.com/verified)

## Newly verified (November 2026)
- [High Clandon Estate Vineyard](https://thatchandtrail.com/v/high-clandon): A small sparkling wine estate on the Clandon Downs, with Tour, Talk, Tasting on Open Days, a summer art and sculpture show, and views across the Surrey Hills to the London skyline.
- [The Grange](https://thatchandtrail.com/v/the-grange): A family estate above the River Itchen with two-hour vineyard and winery tours from February to December, a cellar door six days a week, holiday cottages and summer Thursday Lates.
- [Hattingley Valley](https://thatchandtrail.com/v/hattingley-valley): An award-winning Hampshire sparkling wine producer with behind-the-scenes winery tours and tastings on Saturdays and Sundays, plus Fridays from spring to harvest.
- [Fairmile Vineyard](https://thatchandtrail.com/v/fairmile-vineyard): A dog- and child-friendly vineyard on the Fairmile above Henley, with tours by appointment every day of the year and a 30-minute walk from the station along what William Morris called “the loveliest approach to any town in England”.
- [Chiltern Valley Winery](https://thatchandtrail.com/v/chiltern-valley): A winery, brewery and liqueur maker at Old Luxters in the Chiltern Hills, with tours most days that head out into the vines, a shop open seven days a week and a food truck in the courtyard.
